regression.scope: Native compiler/output run with modeled USER/GDI input; real file I/O, frozen original-x86 expectations

observed: Final /CHECK painted six actual original-resource dialogs, saved an unused CHECKnnn.R1, reloaded all 192 player bytes, cancelled the next wizard and exited cleanly.
Final /SMOKE used the bitmap after saving the starfield preference off; repaint, cleanup and automatic exit passed.
Pioneer/Pioneers created and saved via real Windows dialogs; original Stars! opened it with 25 points and saved a separate ORIGIN.R1.
Original-x86 and reconstructed loaders accepted PIONEER.R1 and ORIGIN.R1; all 192 player-state bytes matched.
Final START2 opened ORIGIN.R1 through the Windows file picker and displayed Pioneer/Pioneers with 25 points.
Changing Jack of All Trades to Alternate Reality changed the description and points to -27; Finish showed the original validation alert and returned to page 2.
Cancelling the modified wizard left the original saved files byte-for-byte unchanged.
Opening the three-byte BROKEN.R1 displayed an error and returned safely to the workshop.
Settings dialog retained both saved checkboxes after restart; saving them off restored bitmap/title startup.
Final START2 saved FINAL.R1 through the real Save dialog, reopened it through Recent Race, and cancelled a subsequent Save without changing the file.
An automated mouse click on Next did not advance the page; Alt+N did. Physical mouse operation remains for user acceptance.
No persistent drawing corruption or guest fault was observed during these runs.
